column2: I die -> my Death effect acts (a unit worth more dead than alive)
I let my own unit die -> an enemy unit dies or is hit (a trade of units, never a gain of supply or strength: that is the Offering)
my dead units and spent cards come back from the discard pile -> their Place acts again
I take my unit back to hand -> I place it again and its Place acts again
my Place or Death effect puts extra small units on the grid -> they fill cells and front cells cheaply (never round-end seeding: Rootkin)
I fill my camp with units -> cards that count my units grow
I place allies -> my units already on the grid react to each placement
my units stand beside, behind or around each other -> they give each other more
I move units inside the camps, mine or the enemy's -> enemies leave the cells facing my dots, mine reach the cells they need
my units attack twice, first, or with an effect on each attack -> every attack (paid in supply) does more
my units have high strength -> the strike beyond the enemy's defence hits the unit behind, and cards that need strength 5+ fire
I make my unit strike a chosen enemy, or make enemies strike -> removal by my unit's strength
my units' text and spells (never round end: Barrage) deal fixed damage to many enemies or many times -> wounded and small enemies are finished, rows are cleared
my spells deal damage -> removal from the hand, no unit needed
I take an enemy's strength or text away for good, or turn it into a harmless unit -> it stays in its cell but does nothing
I gain extra supply or carry-over -> big units come early
my cards get cheaper, free or stronger in hand -> two cards in one turn's supply, or a bigger card for the same supply
I draw extra cards -> more choices each round
I create cards that were not in my deck -> more cards and answers
I pick or copy cards of my deck -> the card I need comes when I need it, a strong one twice
I discard my own cards -> the discarded card acts, or my units grow
I give shields or armour -> the next hit does less or nothing
my unit guards my others or can't be targeted -> enemy attacks and spells must go where I choose
